title: Proposed card, tag and status design
scope: Proposed overlay only; canonical live inventory is supplied separately. No gameplay implementation or approved balance catalog.

canonicalChecks.statusWarning: Similar names do not establish equivalent semantics: proposed Poison is not silently mapped to Venom, Blight to crimsonBlight/necroticBlight, or mirrors to illusionDecoy.

inspection.fullRules: Gain Persistent Block 4 and Persistent Barrier 4. At owner turn start replenish each using its remaining stacks. Lose one stack per qualifying matching-damage event, with no passive per-turn loss. Qualifying threshold and damage-group mapping unresolved; physical/magical is proposed, and Barrier versus existing Ward mapping is unresolved.
Greased adds prone chance and melee/reach accuracy penalty. Fire hit is 100% unavoidable, deals 3× fire damage, applies Burn 3 and splashes 1.5× damage; splash basis unresolved.
